prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, a 20-cell grid body (10 rows, two columns), every cell a genuinely different material, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult American woman in Instagram glam makeup — sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, long voluminous honey-blonde waves, a confident, camera-ready smile. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Two big gold hoops stacked on each ear.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, body divided into a 20-cell grid (10 rows, two columns), each cell a different material, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 20 cells — 10 horizontal rows stacked top to bottom, crossed by one vertical line down the centre splitting each row into a left and right cell — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal; right cell solid transparent deep blue sapphire crystal. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque; right cell carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell carved solid dark wenge wood with fine gold-tan pinstripes, completely opaque; right cell carved solid vivid violet-purple purpleheart wood, completely opaque. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell a glass vessel of clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals; right cell a glass vessel of clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell solid transparent clear sea-blue aquamarine crystal; right cell solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass. Row 6 (left / right body band 6): left cell carved solid deep grey labradorite that flashes blue-green light, completely opaque; right cell carved solid bright blue-green amazonite streaked with white feldspar, completely opaque. Row 7 (left / right body band 7): left cell carved solid golden teak with fine straight grain, completely opaque; right cell carved solid warm cream-to-tan olive wood with dark swirling grain, completely opaque. Row 8 (left / right body band 8): left cell a glass vessel of clear citrine-gold water with drifting fireflies; right cell a glass vessel of clear emerald-green water with drifting water lilies. Row 9 (left / right body band 9): left cell carved solid banded black and white onyx, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque. Row 10 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip): left cell carved solid vivid orange-red Osage orange wood, completely opaque; right cell carved solid dark chocolate-brown bocote wood with bold tiger-stripe patterns, completely opaque.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden orange on one side and a cool teal on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (crystal) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so orange light glances off one side and teal light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
